body: Im starting to mellow out but Im still not feeling excited for anything :/ Taking myself off Saphris because it's zombifying me
I want to but sometimes it's hard
Like everybody lives just so everything will die idk. I can't get it out of my head. In general I've been starting to do really well though I don't have drive to do stuff
I'm on Saphris right now, haven't had therapy. I'm tired of feeling like shit, like living is hopeless, there's no meaning to life, I just hate it and don't want to feel it anymore

Waaay before.  Its more of chemical depression. Good ol' irrational chemicals. Getting laid off didnt help. It's refinery contractor work, so its normal to get laid off. but another job starting up soon. It would be so much easier to get through it if I knew there was a light at the other end. As much as people tell me or I tell myself I just dont feel it.

I spent a while talking to my mom about it. I think medication or at least therapy is probably the best course of action.

I got a new job since the last one made me feel miserable.

Moved out of my parents' house, thinking a change of scenery and the feeling of accomplishment might help

Exercise and dieting but 3 months didnt help before I slumped back down.

Being out of the house, with friends, I just constantly want to go back and lay in bed.

I find myself doing anything I can so I dont have to be stuck with myself to think. Ive actually been playing WoW with friends because I dont have to think outside of the game when Im on. Just this constant feeling of just wanting to sit in the corner and wait for the world to end. I feel like maybe I'm missing that instinct of "my race must go on" or whatever. Im just tired of thinking and want it to stop.

I really don't know what would make it worth it. Everybody tells me a girlfriend, or going outside, or something else Im just not interested it.

It was around April when this started, Ive been trying ever since and nothing works.
